sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 560. Success value 100. 3x magic damage (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases Fire, Water, Wind, Light, Dark, Time, and Star elemental attack by 16 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases fire, water, wind, light, dark, time, and star elemental attack buff limit by 6 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Mastery (increases the maximum number of Defense Skills that can activate by 1) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 120 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Siege for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs; Applies Vital Strike (10% chance to increase damage dealt by 50%). Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Infinite Element (increases all stats by 120%, restores 5% of damage dealt as HP, and increases HP recovery effects by 50%) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Boosts stats of Monsters of all elements by 50% when equipped in the Main Slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 35000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies iron wall for 120 seconds.
Lethargy and Frail Resistance Up by 50
Fire and Water Defense from Unison Damage +600
